He argued that the Asian ally’s legislature had not completed the domestic process to implement the bilateral trade agreement. item.title: Coal spill cleanup operation begins at Teluk Kalong Beach
item.description: CHUKAI: The clean-up operation at Teluk Kalong Beach near here, which was contaminated by the spill of 7,000 metric tonnes of coal from a barge that drifted and broke, began yesterday. Terengganu Department of Environment (DOE) director Hamzah Mohamad said representatives of the barge company involved had appointed contractors to carry out cleanup work involving an area of ​​1.2 kilometres. item.title: Median monthly wage for formal workers increases to RM2,864 – DOSM
item.description: PUTRAJAYA: The median monthly wage for 7.06 million formal workers amounted to RM2,864 in September 2025, an increase of 4.3 percent compared to RM2,745 the previous year, according to the Wage Statistics Report (Formal Sector) Third Quarter 2025 today.
